executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: laundry cost per resident day ($2.59) was 46% of the Connecticut median ($5.66). Ask how laundry is handled: by the home's own staff, by a contracted service, or with costs reported in another department.
Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $226.17 per resident day (46.9% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 9.2% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $294,259, 4.4% of the $6,646,128 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,072,799, $36.51 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $380,937 (35.5%), allocated fringe $92,166 (8.6%), non-wage costs $599,696 (55.9%). Raw food was $274,045 ($9.33 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $258,494.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $244,569, $8.32 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $175,815 (71.9%), allocated fringe $42,538 (17.4%), non-wage costs $26,216 (10.7%).

Missing data: cost year 2023 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data); No related parties or management-service payees were read from the cost year 2025 report. That means none were read, not that none exist.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
